features.name: Over receipt codes
features.description: A feature that allows receiving more products than ordered from vendors. Over receipt codes define tolerance percentages and can be set on both items and vendors, with the most restrictive setting taking effect.
caveats: The most restrictive setting wins when over receipt codes are set on both items and vendors
A default 10% over receipt code is applied if no specific settings are configured

features.name: Over receipt code tolerance percentages
features.description: Over receipt codes can be configured with specific tolerance percentages, such as 10% or 20%, to control how much over receipt is allowed for items or vendors.

features.name: Item-level over receipt codes
features.description: Over receipt codes can be set on individual item cards to define tolerance for over receipt on specific products.

features.name: Vendor-level over receipt codes
features.description: Over receipt codes can be set on vendor cards in the receiving fast tab to define a general over receipt tolerance for all items from that vendor.

features.name: Default over receipt code selection
features.description: A default over receipt code (10%) is pre-selected for all items and vendors, allowing automatic 10% over receipt tolerance if no specific codes are configured.

quotes.text: In Business Central, you can receive more products than you've ordered from your vendor or suppliers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core capability of over receipts, explaining why this feature is needed in real-world purchasing scenarios.
